import numpy as np
import scipy.linalg as la
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(4)

np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True, linewidth=180)
print("Available tensors:", sorted(W))
for l in range(4):
    print("\nLAYER", l)
    for name in ["ln1_w", "ln1_b", "ln2_w", "ln2_b"]:
        a = W[f"{name}.{l}"].astype(np.float64)
        print(name, "min/median/max", np.round(np.quantile(a, [0, .5, 1]), 4),
              "mean/std/norm", np.round([a.mean(), a.std(), la.norm(a)], 4))
    for name in ["W_q", "W_k", "W_v", "W_o", "W_fc", "W_proj"]:
        a = W[f"{name}.{l}"].astype(np.float64)
        sv = la.svdvals(a)
        print(name, "Frob", round(la.norm(a), 3), "svals", np.round(sv[:10], 3),
              "stable_rank", round(np.sum(sv**2) / sv[0]**2, 2))
    print("head: Qnorm Knorm Vnorm Onorm | QK top5, stable_rank, trace/nuclear, symmetric_fraction | OV top5, stable_rank, trace/nuclear")
    for j in range(6):
        s = slice(64*j, 64*(j+1))
        Q = W[f"W_q.{l}"][s].astype(np.float64)
        K = W[f"W_k.{l}"][s].astype(np.float64)
        V = W[f"W_v.{l}"][s].astype(np.float64)
        O = W[f"W_o.{l}"][:, s].astype(np.float64)
        B = Q.T @ K / 8
        C = O @ V
        sb = la.svdvals(B)[:64]
        sc = la.svdvals(C)[:64]
        sym = la.norm((B+B.T)/2)**2 / la.norm(B)**2
        print(f"L{l}H{j}", np.round([la.norm(Q),la.norm(K),la.norm(V),la.norm(O)], 3),
              "|", np.round(sb[:5],3), round(np.sum(sb**2)/sb[0]**2,2),
              round(np.trace(B)/sb.sum(),3), round(sym,3),
              "|", np.round(sc[:5],3), round(np.sum(sc**2)/sc[0]**2,2),
              round(np.trace(C)/sc.sum(),3))
